title: Dungeons LaunchPad
description: This plugin adds a way to turn pistons into launchpads similar to the ones in Minecraft Dungeons!
body:
**To use this plugin use you must place the following blocks below the piston. Depending on the block is the direciton the player will launch.**

Block under piston placement launch direction:
- GOLD_BLOCK → north
- IRON_BLOCK → south
- EMERALD_BLOCK → west
- DIAMOND_BLOCK → east
